question: Which state in India is the source of river Ghaggar?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Himachal Pradesh**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ghaggar**** River, **originates in Shivalik Hills in Himachal Pradesh. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Th**e Ganges is an Asian trans-boundary river** that runs through India and Bangladesh.
 
• The river begins in the western Himalayas in the Indian state of Uttarakhand and flows for 2,525 kilometres.
 
• The **Indus, Ganga, and Brahmaputra rivers are the three major Himalayan rivers.**
 
• These rivers are long and have several tributaries. A river system is made up of a river and its tributaries.
